71670.meaning1: identical destiny; one and the same destination
71670.commentary: (ANa) samasamagatiyo'ti dutiy'attabhāve sabb'ākārena samagatiko ekagatiko. (ANt) samasamagatiyā'ti ka-kārassa ya-kāravasena niddeso'ti āha samabhāven'eva samagatikā'ti.

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, sunettassa satthuno etadahosi, na kho m'etaṃ patirūpaṃ yo'haṃ sāvakānaṃ samasamagatiyo assaṃ abhisamparāyaṃ, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ uttari mettaṃ bhāveyyan'ti.

71671.meaning1: returned again; came back once more

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, sunetto satthā satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvesi. satta vassāni mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvetvā satta saṃvaṭṭavivaṭṭakappe na'y'imaṃ lokaṃ punarāgamāsi. saṃvaṭṭamāne sudaṃ, bhikkhave, loke ābhassarūpago hoti.

71672.meaning1: necessity for a town; requirement for a fort
71672.commentary: (ANa) nagaraparikkhārehi suparikkhatan'ti nagar'ālaṅ'kārehi alaṅ'kataṃ. (VISMa) nagaraparikkhārehī'ti nagaraṃ parivāretvā rakkhaṇakehi. vivaṭaparikkhepo parikkhā uḍḍāpo pākāro esikā paligho pākārapatthaṇḍilan'ti satta nagaraparikkhārā'ti vadanti.

examples.text: yato kho, bhikkhave, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ sattahi nagaraparikkhārehi suparikkhataṃ hoti, catunnañ'ca āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ akaraṇīyaṃ bāhirehi paccatthikehi paccāmittehi.

yato kho, bhikkhave, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ sattahi nagaraparikkhārehi suparikkhataṃ hoti, catunnañ'ca āhārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī. idaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, rañño paccantimaṃ nagaraṃ akaraṇīyaṃ bāhirehi paccatthikehi paccāmittehi.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ āvudhaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti salākañ'c'eva jevanikañ'ca.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ āvudhaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti salākañ'c'eva jevaniyañ'ca.

71676.meaning1: numerous armed forces; many military units

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahubalakāyo paṭivasati, seyyath'idaṃ, hatth'ārohā ass'ārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsakaputtā.

71677.meaning1: mess cook; military chef; (comm) (or) assault troop; shock troop
71677.commentary: (ANa) piṇḍadāyikā'ti sāhasikamahāyodhā. te kira parasenaṃ pavisitvā piṇḍapiṇḍam'iva chetvā chetvā dayanti, uppatitvā niggacchantī'ti attho. ye vā saṅgāmamajjhe yodhānaṃ bhattapānīyaṃ gahetvā pavisanti, tesam'p'etaṃ nāmaṃ.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahubalakāyo paṭivasati, seyyath'idaṃ, hatth'ārohā ass'ārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsakaputtā.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahubalakāyo paṭivasati, seyyath'idaṃ, hatth'ārohā ass'ārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsakaputtā.

71679.commentary: (ANa) pakkhandino'ti ye kassa sīsaṃ vā āvudhaṃ vā āharāmā'ti vatvā asukassā'ti vuttā saṅgāmaṃ pakkhanditvā tadeva āharanti, ime pakkhandantī'ti pakkhandino.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahubalakāyo paṭivasati, seyyath'idaṃ, hatth'ārohā ass'ārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsakaputtā.

71680.commentary: (ANa) mahānāgā viya mahānāgā, hatthi'ādīsu'pi abhimukhaṃ āgacchantesu anivattiyayodhānaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahubalakāyo paṭivasati, seyyath'idaṃ, hatth'ārohā ass'ārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsakaputtā.

71681.meaning1: son of slave; child of a bondservant

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahubalakāyo paṭivasati, seyyath'idaṃ, hatth'ārohā ass'ārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsakaputtā.

71682.commentary: (ANa) cammayodhino'ti ye cammakañcukaṃ vā pavisitvā saraparittāṇacammaṃ vā gahetvā yujjhanti.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahubalakāyo paṭivasati, seyyath'idaṃ, hatth'ārohā ass'ārohā rathikā dhanuggahā celakā calakā piṇḍadāyakā uggā rājaputtā pakkhandino mahānāgā sūrā cammayodhino dāsakaputtā.

71683.commentary: (ANa) vāsanalepanasampanno'ti vāsanena sabbavivarapaṭicchādanena sudhālepena sampanno. bahi vā khāṇupākārasaṅkhātena vāsanena ghanamaṭṭhena ca sudhālepena sampanno puṇṇaghaṭapantiṃ dassetvā katacittakammapaggahitaddhajo.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare pākāro hoti ucco c'eva vitthato ca vāsanalepanasampanno ca.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ sāliyavakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.

71685.meaning1: sesame, mung beans, beans and other crops
71685.compound: dvanda (tila ca mugga ca māsa ca aparaṇṇa)

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ tilamuggamās'āparaṇṇaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rañño paccantime nagare bahuṃ sāliyavakaṃ sannicitaṃ hoti abbhantarānaṃ ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya bāhirānaṃ paṭighātāya.

71687.meaning1: with faith as one's pillar; having confidence like a stone column
71687.commentary: (ANa) saddhesiko'ti saddhaṃ esikāthambhaṃ katvā ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahatī'ti iminā nayena sabbapadesu yojanā kātabbā.

examples.text: evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako saddho hoti, saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ iti'pi so… buddho bhagavā'ti. saddh'esiko, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati.

71688.meaning1: with conscience as a moat; protected by a sense of shame

examples.text: hirīparikkho kho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati. iminā dutiyena saddhammena samannāgato hoti.

71689.meaning1: with sense of shame in wrongdoing as one's encircling patrol path

examples.text: ottappapariyāyapatho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati. iminā tatiyena saddhammena samannāgato hoti.
ottappapariyāyapatho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati. iminā tatiyena saddhammena samannāgato hoti.

71691.commentary: (DNa) sut'āvudhan'ti sutam'eva āvudhaṃ. taṃ atthato tepiṭakaṃ buddhavacanaṃ. tañ'hi nissāya bhikkhu paññ'āvudhaṃ nissāya sūro yodho avikampamāno mahākantāraṃ viya saṃsārakantāraṃ atikkamati avihaññamāno. ten'eva vuttaṃ, sut'āvudho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhamattānaṃ pariharatī'ti (a. ni. 7.67).

examples.text: sut'āvudho, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati. iminā catutthena saddhammena samannāgato hoti.

71692.meaning1: with effort as one's army; with energy as armed force

examples.text: vīriyabalakāyo, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati. iminā pañcamena saddhammena samannāgato hoti.

71693.meaning1: with mindfulness as doorman; with awareness as gatekeeper

examples.text: satidovāriko, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati. iminā chaṭṭhena saddhammena samannāgato hoti.

71694.meaning1: with understanding as one's coating and plastering

examples.text: paññāvāsanalepanasampanno, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako akusalaṃ pajahati, kusalaṃ bhāveti, sāvajjaṃ pajahati, anavajjaṃ bhāveti, suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati. iminā sattamena saddhammena samannāgato hoti.

71695.meaning1: knowing the inferior and superior qualities of a person
71695.commentary: (ANa) evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu puggalaparoparaññū hotī'ti evaṃ bhikkhu puggalānaṃ paroparaṃ tikkhamudubhāvaṃ jānanasamattho nāma hoti.

examples.text: puggalaparoparaññū ca kathaṃ hoti? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno dvayena puggalā viditā honti.

yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ pāricchattako koviḷāro paṇḍupalāso hoti, attamanā, bhikkhave, devā tāvatiṃsā tasmiṃ samaye honti, paṇḍupalāso dāni pāricchattako koviḷāro nacirass'eva dāni pannapalāso bhavissatī'ti.

71697.meaning1: which has shed its leaves; with fallen foliage

examples.text: yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ pāricchattako koviḷāro pannapalāso hoti, attamanā, bhikkhave, devā tāvatiṃsā tasmiṃ samaye honti, pannapalāso dāni pāricchattako koviḷāro nacirass'eva dāni jālakajāto bhavissatī'ti.

71698.commentary: (ANa) khārakajāto'ti pāṭiyekkaṃ sañjātena suvibhattena pattajālakena ca pupphajālakena ca samannāgato.

examples.text: yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ pāricchattako koviḷāro jālakajāto hoti, attamanā, bhikkhave, devā tāvatiṃsā tasmiṃ samaye honti, jālakajāto dāni pāricchattako koviḷāro nacirass'eva dāni khārakajāto bhavissatī'ti.

71699.commentary: (ANa) jālakajāto'ti sañjātapattapupphajālo. tassa hi pattajālañ'ca pupphajālañ'ca sah'eva nikkhamati.

examples.text: yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ pāricchattako koviḷāro pannapalāso hoti, attamanā, bhikkhave, devā tāvatiṃsā tasmiṃ samaye honti, pannapalāso dāni pāricchattako koviḷāro nacirass'eva dāni jālakajāto bhavissatī'ti.
